missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for the failing POST /v1/orders requests to identify the internal 500 cause
Order service metrics (error rate, latency, dependency outcomes) during the incident window
candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces and logs show every checkout failure is caused by an upstream 500 from order, not by gateway faults.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order (db, payment, inventory) is not established; only the order 500 propagation is observed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s are consistently paired with order-service 500s on POST /v1/orders in traces and logs; gateway readiness is healthy and latency is low. The proximate fault is the order service returning 500, but its internal cause is not yet evidenced.
